{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_113",
      "title": "Ensure that SQL server disables public network access",
      "resource": "azurerm_mssql_server.changeme_simple_mssql_server",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "explanation": "The MSSQL server does not explicitly disable public network access, leaving it exposed to the internet by default. This increases the attack surface for brute-force and exploitation attempts."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_AZURE_27",
      "title": "Ensure Azure AD authentication is enabled for Azure SQL (MSSQL)",
      "resource": "azurerm_mssql_server.changeme_simple_mssql_server",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "Azure Active Directory authentication is not configured. Using only SQL Server authentication prevents centralized identity management, MFA enforcement, and conditional access policies."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_23",
      "title": "Ensure that 'Auditing' is set to 'On' for SQL servers",
      "resource": "azurerm_mssql_server.changeme_simple_mssql_server",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "No auditing configuration is present. Without auditing, there is no record of database activities, making incident investigation and compliance reporting impossible."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_52",
      "title": "Ensure MSSQL is using the latest version of TLS encryption",
      "resource": "azurerm_mssql_server.changeme_simple_mssql_server",
      "severity": "LOW",
      "explanation": "The minimum TLS version is not explicitly set to 1.2. Older TLS versions may be negotiated if clients support them, posing a cryptographic weakness."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "resource "azurerm_mssql_server" "changeme_simple_mssql_server" {
  name                = "changeme-simple-mssql-database-name"
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.changeme_simple_mssql_server_resource_group.name
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.changeme_simple_mssql_server_resource_group.location
  version             = "12.0"
  administrator_login          = "changemeadmin"
  administrator_login_password = "ch4ng3m3-A@Â£$%^&"
  
  # Disable public network access (CKV_AZURE_113)
  public_network_access_enabled = false
  
  # Enforce TLS 1.2 (CKV_AZURE_52)
  minimum_tls_version = "1.2"
}

# Enable Azure AD Authentication (CKV2_AZURE_27)
resource "azurerm_mssql_server_active_directory_administrator" "example" {
  server_name         = azurerm_mssql_server.changeme_simple_mssql_server.name
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.changeme_simple_mssql_server_resource_group.name
  login               = "sqladmin"
  object_id           = data.azuread_group.example.object_id
  tenant_id           = data.azurerm_client_config.current.tenant_id
}

data "azuread_group" "example" {
  display_name = "SQL Admins"
}

data "azurerm_client_config" "current" {}

# Configure Auditing (CKV_AZURE_23, CKV_AZURE_24)
resource "azurerm_storage_account" "audit_logs" {
  name                     = "changemestorageacct"
  resource_group_name      = azurerm_resource_group.changeme_simple_mssql_server_resource_group.name
  location                 = azurerm_resource_group.changeme_simple_mssql_server_resource_group.location
  account_tier             = "Standard"
  account_replication_type = "LRS"
}

resource "azurerm_mssql_server_security_alert_policy" "example" {
  resource_group_name        = azurerm_resource_group.changeme_simple_mssql_server_resource_group.name
  server_name                = azurerm_mssql_server.changeme_simple_mssql_server.name
  storage_endpoint           = azurerm_storage_account.audit_logs.primary_blob_endpoint
  retention_days             = 90
  email_account_admins       = true
  email_addresses            = ["security@example.com"]
  disabled_alerts            = []
}

resource "azurerm_mssql_server_audit_setting" "example" {
  server_name                = azurerm_mssql_server.changeme_simple_mssql_server.name
  resource_group_name        = azurerm_resource_group.changeme_simple_mssql_server_resource_group.name
  storage_endpoint           = azurerm_storage_account.audit_logs.primary_blob_endpoint
  retention_days             = 90
  audit_actions_included     = ["SUCCESSFUL_DATABASE_AUTHENTICATION_GROUP", "FAILED_DATABASE_AUTHENTICATION_GROUP", "BATCH_COMPLETED_GROUP"]
}",
  "fix_summary": "Disabled public network access and enforced TLS 1.2 on the MSSQL server. Added resources to enable Azure AD authentication, create a storage account for logs, and configure security alert policies and audit settings with a 90-day retention period."
}
